summary: Describes a Uniform Resource Name (URN) namespace for naming XML formats and protocols that extend XMPP, when those are defined in specifications published by the XMPP Standards Foundation. It gives such extensions stable, unique names. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Every extra feature for a chat system needs a unique name tag so nobody mixes them up. This note creates the system for making those name tags.
